title: DSPT 10 Years: Braga Meetup @ Subvisual
description:
DSPT turns 10 this year, and we’re celebrating in **Braga** too 🏛️

Join us at Subvisual for an evening with Braga’s AI and data community.

We’ll be joined by:
🎤 Margarida Lobato Costa \| Cegid
🎤 Pedro Costa \| Condukt

📅 September 30
🕕 18:00–20:30
📍 Subvisual — Pólo de Negócios de Braga
Avenida Dom João II, 404, 4.º andar
4715-275 Braga

Save your spot and come celebrate 10 years of DSPT with us!
See you in Braga!
